name: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD

achievements.name: Loftwing
achievements.detail: Finish the Wing Ceremony, call your Loftwing, and fly a loop around Skyloft.

achievements.name: Goddess Sword
achievements.detail: Draw the Goddess Sword from its pedestal and meet Fi, the spirit bound to the blade.

achievements.name: Below the Clouds
achievements.detail: Drop from Skyloft, break through the cloud barrier, and stand on the surface.

achievements.name: Skyview Temple
achievements.detail: Clear Skyview Temple by beating the creature at its heart and opening the exit.

achievements.name: Earth Temple
achievements.detail: Cross the Eldin temple through the heat and defeat the boss in its depths.

achievements.name: Mining Facility
achievements.detail: Restore the Lanayru Mining Facility and finish the trial waiting at the end of the line.

achievements.name: Silent Realm
achievements.detail: Collect every sacred tear in a Silent Realm before the guardians reach you.

achievements.name: Master Sword
achievements.detail: Temper the Goddess Sword in the three sacred flames until it becomes the Master Sword.

achievements.name: Goddess Cube
achievements.detail: Strike a Goddess Cube on the surface, then open the chest that appears back in the sky.

achievements.name: The Imprisoned
achievements.detail: Halt the Imprisoned on its climb out of the pit and drive it back down.

achievements.name: Gratitude Crystals
achievements.detail: Earn Gratitude Crystals by completing favors for people living on Skyloft.

achievements.name: Hero of the Skies
achievements.detail: Carry the journey from your first flight all the way through the ending credits.
